Humanity Insured Innovation Fund

Humanity Insured is pleased to announce its 2026 call for innovative parametric insurance pilots serving vulnerable communities across Central America.

The call opens on 10 January 2026 and applications close on March 31, 2026. Grants are available ranging from $10,000 to $75,000 per selected pilot, disbursed in two tranches.

Priority will be given to proposals from Guatemala and El Salvador with a clear path to scale.
